name: karma-nativescript-launcher
description: Karma launcher for `nativescript test android`/`nativescript test ios`. Own implementation (forked from NativeScript/karma-nativescript-launcher, MIT/Apache-2.0) - see VITE_MIGRATION_NOTES.md for why: karma's singleRun completion bookkeeping needs the device to report back the exact id this launcher assigned it, which the upstream package never did.
